title: Lesion-Aware External Evaluation of Dermoscopic Melanoma Classifiers under Dataset Shift: reproducibility code and outputs
description: Reproducibility code and derived outputs for lesion-aware external evaluation of dermoscopic melanoma classifiers. The release includes corrected external inference with lesion-clustered uncertainty, source-derived operating thresholds transported from HAM10000 to BCN20000, lesion-mean sensitivity analyses, segmentation robustness checks, reference-standard sensitivity analyses, and saliency diagnostics. Earlier BCN-derived fixed-specificity and decision-curve analyses are superseded.
